owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The owner decision of 30 Oct 2026 names the registry, the image name and the tags, but no signed criterion publishes an image, and the release workflow contract WO-01-A AC02 states that the tag-triggered build tests, builds and attaches and publishes nothing, so the publish cannot live in that workflow. This contract adds a maintainer-run publish script that pushes the image after the Docker smoke of SO-R-B passes against the local build, smokes the published image, and refuses to run without the owner's go for the first public image (MEM-141 AC07) recorded in the release checklist. The account is read at run time from MEMEV_IMAGE_OWNER or the origin remote URL and is never written in the script or the docs.

title: SO-R-E Publish the versioned container image by a maintainer-run script after the Docker smoke passes: the registry account read from the environment or the origin remote, image name memev, tags the version and the sha, a published-image smoke, and the owner's go for the first public image
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-R-E) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. No SO-1.x or SO-2.x design record covers this contract; it is cited from the work breakdown (docs/scope-one/WBS.md) instead. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-R-B†, WO-01-A†. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 1 (reconcile claims with what is built). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) The fold used a stub docker on PATH described in SO-R-B AC03 and a placeholder image name; neither exists on main. scripts/docker-smoke.sh is on main and takes a shell-function stub the test defines itself; the image name is the local tag memev:local. (4) The owner-go marker the fold said the checklist records is defined here: docs/RELEASING.md gets a line the script reads, and the test runs without it. (5) Overlap check: SR-6.03 publishes the image from the release workflow with a signed tag. This contract is the maintainer-run script for the first public image and its published smoke; it does not touch .github/workflows/release.yml, and SR-6.03 stays the owner of the automated publish.
